go_no_go.rationale: The checkpoint and dataset licenses are NOT_DECLARED (verdict=blocking on both). An undeclared license is a reserved right, never a permissive default (ADR 0369 D1/D2); the repo-level Apache-2.0 grant does not inherit downward onto the checkpoint or dataset (ADR 0473 D4 precedent for the same weakening pattern).
